name: Modify Asset
description: Modify and delete existing asset members and their properties in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning

getLastEvent.description: Returns the last event generated by the Modify Asset widget.

getData.description: Returns all loaded asset rows as serialized JSON.

setData.description: Loads asset rows into the widget.

setCellValue.description: Sets a value in an asset row.

getSelectedData.description: Returns selected asset rows as serialized JSON.

getModifiedData.description: Returns modified asset rows as serialized JSON.

setOptions.description: Sets dropdown options for a field.

markSaved.description: Marks the current widget rows as saved.

removeRowsById.description: Removes rows from the widget by asset ID.

onReady.description: Triggered when the widget is ready.

onDataChange.description: Triggered when data is loaded, selected, edited, cleared, saved, or when deletion is requested.
